items.title: 當AI房東穩賺？華爾街熱推資料中心 風險卻愈堆愈高
items.title_en: When AI Landlords Seem Surefire? Wall Street Pushes Data Centers, but Risks Keep Mounting
paras: AI熱潮帶動資料中心投資，華爾街正將這類基礎設施包裝成房地產配置選項，吸引投資人分享數位經濟成長。然而，從股價下跌、地方反對聲浪，到電力供應與資金流動性限制，風險也逐漸浮現，顯示資料中心並非只要搭上AI商機，就能穩賺租金。
據《CNBC》報導，這類投資目前仍以退休基金等機構法人為主，但黑石集團(BX-US)、藍鴞資本(Blue Owl)(OWL-US)等另類資產管理業者，正透過上市不動產投資信託(REIT)等方式，擴大投資人參與管道。

華爾街搶推資料中心投資 上市表現未必跟上AI熱潮

黑石今年推出Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust(BXDC-US)，鎖定北維吉尼亞、達拉斯等成熟市場的既有資料中心。執行長佩爾(Nick Pell)認為，相較於開發新案，投資營運成熟的設施風險較低，未來數年潛在市場規模可望突破1兆美元。
不過，該REIT於5月中旬以每股20美元發行8,750萬股，周四收盤已跌破17美元，較發行價下跌約16%，且目前尚未投入資金進行投資。資料中心REIT業者Equinix(EQIX-US)與Digital Realty Trust(DLR-US)長期表現雖佳，同期股價也陷入停滯。
藍鴞資本則傳出考慮將既有資料中心投資整合為上市REIT，估值最高65億美元。公司表示，在全球32個市場擁有逾130座資料中心，資產超過180億美元，並強調租約設有保障，即使租戶提前退出，也能取得補償。
然而，利率與美債殖利率上升會提高融資成本，也削弱收息型資產的吸引力。REIT今年漲幅多集中在債市壓力加劇前，8月以來已有不少相關投資遭到拋售。

地方反彈與電力瓶頸升溫 長約難擋所有開發風險

政治阻力也在擴大。蓋洛普調查顯示，70%美國民眾反對在住家附近興建資料中心。紐約州7月暫停核准新的超大規模資料中心，德州8月跟進，讓投資人必須重新評估許可延誤對預期報酬的影響。
甲骨文(ORCL-US)9月底針對新墨西哥州、由藍鴞資本開發的Project Jupiter資料中心園區發出不可抗力通知，若計畫未能於2028年投入營運，尋求延後付款，理由包括監管障礙與地方反對。儘管公司表示進度仍符合計畫，消息仍拖累股價下跌4%。
蓋茨堡學院財務教授莫拉(Sabur Mollah)指出，雲端、AI與資料儲存需求，確實可支撐資料中心長期發展，優質設施與大型科技公司簽訂長約，也有助取得穩定租金。
但這類資產需要龐大資本，仰賴可靠的電力、冷卻與網路設施，另有估值過高、租戶集中、技術過時、再融資及持續維護支出等風險。天災或設備停機，也可能讓業者無法履行服務承諾，保險只能協助分攤部分損失。

散戶參與管道增加 私募基金贖回限制須看清

目前散戶參與仍有限，黑石這檔上市REIT約94%由機構持有。不過，美國證券交易委員會(SEC)主席阿特金斯(Paul Atkins)近期提出擴大散戶參與私募投資的方案，相關產品未來可能更加普及。
投資人尤其需要區分上市REIT與私募基金。前者可在交易所買賣，後者可能設有贖回窗口及額度限制，能買進不代表隨時能取回資金。InvestCloud主管塔弗(Andrew Tarver)指出，私募市場原本是為少數機構的大額、低頻交易設計，未必適合大量散戶頻繁進出。
財富顧問法爾肯(Jake Falcon)認為，資料中心基金可作為小比例、長期配置，但投資前仍須確認是否符合資金用途與整體目標，並充分理解產品結構，不能只因AI題材熱門就貿然投入。
paras_en: The AI boom is driving data‑center investment, and Wall Street is packaging this infrastructure as a real‑estate allocation option to let investors share in the digital‑economy growth. Yet risks are emerging—from falling stock prices and local opposition to power‑supply constraints and liquidity limits—showing that data centers aren’t a guaranteed rent‑check just because they ride the AI wave.

According to CNBC, most of this capital currently comes from institutional investors such as pension funds, but alternative‑asset managers like Blackstone (BX‑US) and Blue Owl (OWL‑US) are expanding investor access through publicly listed REITs.

Wall Street is aggressively promoting data‑center investments, but listed performance may not keep pace with the AI hype. Blackstone launched the Blackstone Digital Infrastructure Trust (BXDC‑US) this year, targeting existing data‑center assets in mature markets such as Northern Virginia and Dallas. CEO Nick Pell argues that buying and operating mature facilities carries lower risk than greenfield development, and the market could exceed $1 trillion in the next few years.

However, the REIT issued 87.5 million shares at $20 each in mid‑May and closed Thursday below $17, about a 16% discount to the IPO price, and it has yet to deploy any capital. While data‑center REITs like Equinix (EQIX‑US) and Digital Realty Trust (DLR‑US) have performed well over the long term, their stock prices have also stalled recently.

Blue Owl is reportedly considering bundling its existing data‑center holdings into a listed REIT, with a valuation that could reach $6.5 billion. The firm says it operates more than 130 data centers across 32 markets, with assets over $18 billion, and stresses that leases are protected so that even if a tenant exits early, compensation is secured.

Rising interest rates and U.S. Treasury yields increase financing costs and diminish the appeal of yield‑focused assets. REIT gains this year were largely concentrated before bond‑market pressure intensified, and many related positions have been sold off since August.

Local backlash and power‑supply bottlenecks are adding to development risk. A Gallup poll shows 70% of Americans oppose building data centers near residential areas. New York halted approvals for new hyperscale data centers in July, and Texas followed in August, forcing investors to reassess the impact of permitting delays on expected returns.

Oracle (ORCL‑US) issued a force‑majeure notice at the end of September for the Project Jupiter data‑center campus in New Mexico, being developed by Blue Owl. If the project cannot be operational by 2028, Oracle will seek delayed payments, citing regulatory hurdles and local opposition. Although the company says the schedule remains on track, the news dragged the stock down 4%.

Finance professor Sabur Mollah of Gatesburg College notes that cloud, AI and data‑storage demand can indeed sustain long‑term data‑center growth; high‑quality facilities with long‑term contracts from large tech firms help secure stable rent streams.

But these assets require massive capital, reliable power, cooling and network infrastructure, and face risks such as overvaluation, tenant concentration, technological obsolescence, refinancing needs and ongoing maintenance costs. Natural disasters or equipment failures could prevent operators from meeting service commitments, with insurance only covering part of the loss.

Retail investor participation remains limited; about 94% of Blackstone’s listed REIT is held by institutions. However, SEC Chair Paul Atkins has recently proposed expanding retail access to private‑investment products, which could make such offerings more common in the future.

Investors need to distinguish between listed REITs and private funds. The former trade on exchanges, while the latter may have redemption windows and caps, meaning buying does not guarantee immediate cash‑out. Andrew Tarver of InvestCloud points out that the private market was designed for a few institutions’ large, low‑frequency trades and may not suit frequent retail turnover.

Wealth advisor Jake Falcon says data‑center funds can be a small‑percentage, long‑term allocation, but investors should verify that they fit their liquidity needs and overall objectives and fully understand the product structure, rather than jumping in simply because AI is trendy.

items.title: 美債還沒跌完？四大警訊浮現 殖利率恐再衝高
items.title_en: U.S. Treasuries Still Not Fully Fallen? Four Major Warning Signs Emerge, Yields May Surge Again
paras: 美債殖利率攀抵逾20年高點，市場擔心賣壓可能愈演愈烈。從利率選擇權避險需求升溫、AI企業大舉發債，到房貸資產避險與長天期公債承壓，四項訊號顯示，債市拋售可能形成連鎖反應，進一步推高殖利率。
據《路透》報導，自2月美伊戰爭爆發以來，10年期美債殖利率累計上升約135個基點至5.23%；30年期殖利率則自3月低點上升約110個基點至5.614%，雙雙來到20多年前才見過的水準。
不過，高殖利率也可能吸引買盤，讓投資人鎖定小布希執政以來少見的收益水準。市場目前關注的是，這股承接力能否抵銷避險交易與資金調整所帶來的額外賣壓。

利率避險需求升溫 市場防範殖利率再衝高

第一項警訊來自利率選擇權。投資人正加碼防範利率上升的保護性部位，希望在不出售美債持倉的情況下，降低殖利率急升造成的損失。
針對未來三個月10年期美元利率交換利率上升200個基點的避險需求明顯增加，相關保護成本周一升至132個基點，創2023年3月矽谷銀行倒閉引發銀行危機以來最高。
利率交換是以固定利率交換浮動利率的契約。雖然這類選擇權連結的是交換利率，而非美債殖利率，但兩者通常同向變動，因此防範利率上漲的選擇權相對昂貴，反映市場對長期美債殖利率續升的擔憂。
此外，10年期利率交換的一個月期選擇權隱含波動率升至21.4個基點，創3月底以來最高，顯示市場對長期利率走勢的不確定性增加。

AI發債與房貸避險交織 美債承受額外賣壓

第二項壓力來自AI基礎建設融資。大型科技業者為擴建資料中心等設施，持續發行公司債。雖然信用利差仍低，但買進這些長天期債券的投資人，會透過賣出美債期貨，降低投資組合對利率上升的敏感度。
RBC BlueBay Asset Management投資組合經理Neil Sun表示，公司債交易中午定價後，下午往往就出現大量美債期貨賣單。部分投資人則直接出售美債，騰出資金買進收益率較高的投資等級公司債。
高盛(GS-US)預估，大型雲端與AI業者明年發債規模可能達創紀錄的4,200億美元，意味相關避險或美債出售需求可能持續增加。
第三項警訊是房貸資產避險加速。利率上升時，借款人提前還款或轉貸的意願下降，房貸抵押證券(MBS)的預期存續期間因而拉長，也更容易受到利率進一步上升的衝擊。
投資人通常會增加利率避險，包括賣出美債期貨，抵銷這種新增風險。這類「凸性避險」可能形成循環：殖利率愈升，避險賣盤愈多，又進一步加重債市壓力。
Eris Innovations執行長Mike Riddle指出，過去三年承作的房貸中，有相當大一部分票面利率接近目前房貸利率，因此可能引發更多避險需求，本月九筆大型交易已顯示投資人積極保護部位。

長債殖利率升得更快 財政疑慮推高持債補償

第四項訊號是10年期與30年期美債殖利率差距再度擴大。本周兩者利差約37個基點，反映30年期殖利率上升速度更快，投資人要求更高報酬，才願意持有最長天期公債。
這項利差雖仍低於7月底的52個基點，但目前殖利率已接近數十年高點，顯示市場變化愈來愈反映「期限溢價」上升，也就是持有長期債券所要求的額外補償，而不只是重新評估聯準會(Fed)利率政策。
F/m Investments共同創辦人Alex Morris表示，投資人對10年期美債的興趣高於30年期，因為時間拉長，美國財政出問題的可能性也更令人擔憂。這反映市場對政府能否掌控長期財政局勢，仍缺乏信心。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury yields have climbed to over‑20‑year highs, prompting market fears that selling pressure could intensify. From rising demand for interest‑rate option hedges and a wave of AI‑company bond issuances to mortgage‑asset hedging and pressure on long‑dated sovereign bonds, four signals suggest a bond‑market sell‑off could trigger a chain reaction that pushes yields higher.

According to Reuters, since the outbreak of the U.S.–Iran war in February, the 10‑year Treasury yield has risen about 135 basis points to 5.23%, while the 30‑year yield has climbed roughly 110 basis points since its March low to 5.614%, both levels last seen more than two decades ago.

However, high yields could also attract buyers, allowing investors to lock in a return level rarely seen since the Bush administration. The market is now watching whether this buying strength can offset the extra selling pressure generated by hedging trades and fund reallocations.

Rising demand for rate hedges signals market concerns that yields could climb further. The first warning comes from interest‑rate options, as investors increase protective positions against rising rates, hoping to limit losses from a rapid yield surge without having to sell Treasury holdings.

Hedging demand for a 200‑basis‑point rise in the 10‑year USD interest‑rate swap over the next three months has surged, pushing the related protection cost up to 132 basis points on Monday – the highest since the March 2023 Silicon Valley Bank collapse triggered a banking crisis.

An interest‑rate swap is a contract that exchanges a fixed rate for a floating rate. Although these options are linked to swap rates rather than Treasury yields, the two usually move in tandem, making rate‑rise protection relatively expensive and reflecting market worries that long‑term Treasury yields will keep climbing.

In addition, the one‑month implied volatility of the 10‑year swap option rose to 21.4 basis points, the highest since the end of March, indicating growing uncertainty about the trajectory of long‑term rates.

AI‑driven financing adds a second pressure. Large tech firms are continuously issuing corporate bonds to fund data‑center expansions and other infrastructure. While credit spreads remain low, investors buying these long‑dated bonds often hedge by selling Treasury futures to reduce portfolio sensitivity to rising rates.

Neil Sun, portfolio manager at RBC BlueBay Asset Management, said that after corporate‑bond pricing settles at midday, a flood of Treasury‑future sell orders typically appears in the afternoon. Some investors even sell Treasuries outright to free up cash for higher‑yielding investment‑grade corporate debt.
Goldman Sachs (GS‑US) estimates that large cloud and AI companies could issue a record $420 billion in bonds next year, meaning hedging or Treasury‑selling demand could stay elevated.

The third warning is accelerating mortgage‑asset hedging. When rates rise, borrowers are less likely to prepay or refinance, extending the expected life of mortgage‑backed securities (MBS) and making them more vulnerable to further rate hikes.

Investors usually increase rate hedges, including selling Treasury futures, to offset this added risk. Such “convexity hedging” can become a feedback loop: higher yields spur more hedge‑sell orders, which in turn adds pressure to the bond market.

Mike Riddle, CEO of Eris Innovations, noted that a large portion of the mortgages originated over the past three years carry coupon rates close to current mortgage rates, potentially spurring more hedging demand; nine large deals this month already show investors actively protecting their positions.

The fourth signal is a widening spread between 10‑year and 30‑year Treasury yields. This week the spread is about 37 basis points, reflecting faster gains in the 30‑year yield and investors demanding higher compensation to hold the longest‑dated sovereign debt.

Although the spread remains below the 52‑basis‑point gap seen at the end of July, yields are now near multi‑decade highs, indicating the market is increasingly pricing in a higher term premium – extra compensation for holding long‑dated bonds beyond just reassessing the Fed’s policy stance.

Alex Morris, co‑founder of F/m Investments, said investors favor the 10‑year over the 30‑year because the longer horizon raises concerns about U.S. fiscal stability. This reflects lingering doubts about the government’s ability to manage long‑term fiscal risks.

items.title: 撤換Fed理事再出招！川普組調查小組 庫克律師嗆走過場
items.title_en: Trump Administration Moves Again to Oust Fed Governor Cook; Trump Team Investigates, Cook's Lawyer Calls It a Stunt
paras: 美國總統川普再度推進撤換聯準會(Fed)理事庫克(Lisa Cook)的行動，正式成立調查委員會，檢視她涉嫌在房貸文件中作出不實陳述的指控，並要求她於11月5日赴白宮出席不公開聽證會。庫克否認不法，其律師質疑程序合法性，但表示願意提出事實，證明沒有將她免職的法律依據。
綜合外媒報導，白宮周五(9日)公布一份日期為周三的總統備忘錄，要求委員會調查相關指控，並向川普報告，是否存在《聯邦準備法》所要求、足以撤換Fed理事的法定事由。聽證會安排在期中選舉後兩天，庫克可事先提交書面陳述，並由律師陪同出席。

白宮官員組成調查小組 庫克律師質疑程序公正性

委員會三名成員均來自行政部門，包括白宮國家經濟委員會主任哈塞特(Kevin Hassett)、政府倫理局代理局長桑德林(Keith Sonderling)，以及公平就業機會委員會主席盧卡斯(Andrea Lucas)，未列入外部獨立人士。委員會可諮詢司法部及其他機關，協助調查。
川普在備忘錄中表示，總統有責任確保法律忠實執行，包括撤換無法被信任會誠實陳述及遵守法律的下屬。他長期要求Fed降息，近期更將自己提名的主席華許未能降息，歸咎於「充滿敵意」的理事會。
庫克的律師羅威爾(Abbe Lowell)與艾森(Norm Eisen)表示，川普已多次表明不論證據為何都要撤換庫克，因此對聽證會是否合法抱持重大疑慮。他們正與白宮接洽，確認程序是否具有實質意義，而非只是走過場。
律師強調，只要調查接近客觀，就會得出庫克未涉及房貸詐欺、沒有理由將她免職的結論。Fed則不予置評，請媒體洽詢庫克律師。

最高法院要求正當程序 免職事由仍是攻防核心

川普去年8月首度宣布撤換庫克，起因是聯邦住房金融局局長普爾特(Bill Pulte)指控她在貸款申請中說謊，以取得優惠條件。庫克隨即提告，否認指控，並主張相關指控不足以構成法定免職事由。
最高法院今年6月以5比4裁定，庫克可在訴訟期間留任，認為川普先前未給予充分通知及辯護機會，但未禁止白宮重新啟動程序。判決曾援引前總統塔虎脫1912年成立調查委員會的案例，卻未具體規定程序形式。
福坦莫大學法學教授曼納斯(Jane Manners)認為，川普此舉看似回應最高法院的程序要求，但法院對撤換Fed理事的事由設下高門檻，並強調央行應免於政治干預，這仍將是後續訴訟核心。
參議院銀行委員會民主黨首席議員華倫批評，川普正透過不合法的「作秀審判」企圖控制央行。司法部與庫克律師預定11月6日、也就是聽證會隔天，向華府聯邦法官提交報告，說明原有訴訟的後續安排。
paras_en: U.S. President Donald Trump is once again pushing to remove Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook, formally establishing an investigative committee to examine accusations that she made false statements in mortgage documents, and demanding she appear at a closed‑door hearing at the White House on November 5. Cook denies any wrongdoing, her lawyer questions the legality of the process, but says she will present facts to show there is no legal basis for her removal.

According to foreign media reports, the White House on Friday the 9th released a presidential memorandum dated Wednesday that orders the committee to investigate the allegations and report to Trump whether there are statutory grounds under the Federal Reserve Act sufficient to remove a Fed governor. The hearing is scheduled for two days after the midterm elections; Cook may submit a written statement in advance and be accompanied by counsel.

White House officials have formed the investigative panel, and Cook's lawyer has raised concerns about procedural fairness. All three committee members come from the executive branch: Kevin Hassett, director of the White House National Economic Council; Keith Sonderling, acting director of the Office of Government Ethics; and Andrea Lucas, chair of the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission. No external independent members were appointed. The committee may consult the Justice Department and other agencies for assistance.

In the memorandum, Trump wrote that the president has a duty to ensure faithful execution of the law, including removing subordinates who cannot be trusted to be honest and comply with the law. He has long pressed the Fed to cut rates, and recently blamed his own nominee for chair Wes Moore’s failure to cut rates on a "hostile" board of governors.

Cook's attorneys, Abbe Lowell and Norm Eisen, said Trump has repeatedly indicated he will fire Cook regardless of the evidence, raising serious doubts about the legality of the hearing. They are in talks with the White House to confirm whether the process has any substantive meaning or is merely a perfunctory exercise.

The lawyers emphasized that if the investigation is conducted objectively, it will conclude that Cook was not involved in mortgage fraud and there is no justification for her removal. The Fed declined to comment and directed media inquiries to Cook's counsel.

The Supreme Court has demanded due process, keeping the grounds for removal at the heart of the dispute. Trump first announced his intent to oust Cook in August last year after Federal Housing Finance Agency head Bill Pulte accused her of lying on loan applications to secure favorable terms. Cook promptly sued, denied the allegations, and argued the claims do not meet the statutory threshold for removal.

In June this year the Supreme Court ruled 5‑4 that Cook may remain in office during the litigation, finding that Trump had not provided adequate notice and an opportunity to defend, but it did not bar the White House from restarting the removal process. The decision cited a 1912 investigation committee established by former President Taft, but did not specify procedural details.

Law professor Jane Manners of Fordham University said Trump's move appears to respond to the Supreme Court's procedural demands, but the Court has set a high bar for grounds to remove a Fed governor and stressed that the central bank should be insulated from political interference, which will remain a key issue in future lawsuits.

Senate Banking Committee Democratic ranking member Sherrod Brown criticized Trump for attempting to control the central bank through an unlawful "show trial." The Justice Department and Cook's lawyers plan to file a report with a federal judge in Washington on November 6, the day after the hearing, outlining the next steps in the existing litigation.

items.title: AI需求看不到盡頭 Lumentum：光學元件訂單滿到2029年 部分產品缺口達七成
items.title_en: AI Demand Shows No End in Sight Lumentum: Optical Component Orders Booked Through 2029, Some Products Face a 70% Shortfall
paras: Lumentum Holdings(LITE-US)執行長Michael Hurlston周五(9日)表示，由於科技業爭相興建更高速的人工智慧(AI)資料中心，該公司接下來到2029年初的光學元件產能已被「預訂一空」。
Hurlston在東京受訪時表示，該公司部分產品從現在一直到明年的需求，將有約七成無法滿足，其他一些產品的需求缺口，甚至到2028年仍有三成無法供應。僅僅六個月前，Hurlston曾表示，Lumentum產能要到2028年才會售罄。
Lumentum與同業Coherent(COHR-US)今年稍早各自獲得輝達(NVDA-US)20億美元投資。Lumentum供應先進磷化銦元件，協助實現高速雲端運算與資料傳輸。分析師預期，Lumentum今年營收將較去年成長逾一倍。
Hurlston說：「我們真的在努力迎頭趕上，盡可能快速擴充產能，但與客戶的需求相比，我們仍落後非常、非常多。產能已經全部售罄，因此看不到需求何時才會出現盡頭。」

AI基建需求強 供應商擴產仍追不上

隨著全球大舉興建資料中心及其他AI基礎設施，部分投資人開始對隨之而來的成本上升與債務膨脹更加謹慎。為了緩解關鍵供應商的疑慮，大型科技公司開始為長期協議提供保障。
此外，隨著美國傳出考慮禁止新款中國光收發器上市，業界也正為供應進一步吃緊做準備。Counterpoint Research指出，若光迅科技(Innolight)等中國廠商留下供應缺口，Lumentum與Coherent也無法完全填補。
為因應激增的需求，Lumentum過去兩年已將東京都會區主要工廠的產能擴大至12倍。該公司計劃在該廠及鄰近設施投資至少3.5億美元，並已擴充位於英國卡斯威爾(Caswell)的工廠產能。
不過Hurlston表示，若要擴大產品線，可能必須考慮透過併購取得新技術或能力。他說：「我認為，我們可能希望在未來一年內，為現有業務增加額外的產能。」
Hurlston表示，像Lumentum這類公司，通常需要三到五年才能建置新的產能，不過超大規模雲端服務商(hyperscalers)已同意投入資金支持。

矽光子技術受矚目 日本供應鏈握優勢

矽光子技術利用光傳輸資料。由於先進AI硬體對傳輸速度的要求不斷提高，矽光子預料將逐步取代資料中心叢集內以銅為基礎的互連技術。光學網路也有助於降低系統產生的熱量與耗電量。
日本擁有廣泛的相關技術供應鏈，涵蓋磷化銦半導體、光纖及矽光子技術，代表企業包括藤倉(Fujikura)、住友電工(Sumitomo Electric Industries)、古河電工(Furukawa Electric)、濱松光子學(Hamamatsu Photonics)、三菱電機(Mitsubishi Electric)及日立高新技術(Hitachi High-Tech)。
Lumentum部分技術來自日本，因該公司在2018年收購承接了日立(Hitachi)光學研究成果的Oclaro。Lumentum位於日本相模原的廠區，如今已是全球最先進的磷化銦元件生產據點之一，具備穩定供應高品質產品的能力。
今年稍早，以色列矽光子晶圓代工業者Tower Semiconductor取得日本中部富山縣魚津市一座300毫米晶圓廠的控制權，並計劃擴大光子產品出貨量。
(本文不開放合作夥伴轉載)
paras_en: Lumentum Holdings (LITE-US) CEO Michael Hurlston said on Friday (the 9th) that, as the tech industry races to build faster AI data centers, the company’s optical component capacity through early 2029 is already "fully booked."

Hurlston told reporters in Tokyo that demand for some of the company’s products from now until next year will be about 70% unmet, and the shortfall for other products will remain at roughly 30% even through 2028. Just six months ago, Hurlston had said Lumentum’s capacity would not be sold out until 2028.

Earlier this year Lumentum and peer Coherent (COHR-US) each secured a $2 billion investment from Nvidia (NVDA-US). Lumentum supplies advanced indium phosphide components that enable high‑speed cloud computing and data transmission. Analysts expect Lumentum’s revenue this year to more than double that of last year.

Hurlston said, "We are really working hard to catch up, expanding capacity as quickly as possible, but we are still far, far behind customer demand. Capacity is completely sold out, so we can’t see when demand will ever run out."

AI infrastructure demand is strong, but suppliers’ capacity expansions are still lagging. As data centers and other AI infrastructure are built worldwide, some investors are becoming more cautious about rising costs and debt. To ease key suppliers’ concerns, large tech firms are beginning to provide guarantees for long‑term agreements.

In addition, with reports that the United States is considering banning new Chinese optical transceivers from the market, the industry is preparing for tighter supply. Counterpoint Research notes that if Chinese firms such as Innolight leave a supply gap, Lumentum and Coherent will not be able to fill it completely.

To meet the surge in demand, Lumentum has expanded capacity at its main plant in the Tokyo metropolitan area twelve‑fold over the past two years. The company plans to invest at least $350 million in that plant and nearby facilities and has also expanded capacity at its factory in Caswell, United Kingdom.

However, Hurlston said that expanding the product line may require acquiring new technology or capabilities through acquisitions. He added, "I think we may want to add additional capacity to our existing business within the next year."
Hurlston noted that companies like Lumentum typically need three to five years to build new capacity, but hyperscale cloud providers have agreed to fund the effort.

Silicon‑photonics technology is attracting attention, and Japan’s supply chain holds an advantage. Silicon photonics uses light to transmit data. As advanced AI hardware demands ever‑higher transmission speeds, silicon photonics is expected to gradually replace copper‑based interconnects inside data‑center clusters. Optical networking also helps reduce system heat and power consumption.

Japan has a broad related‑technology supply chain covering indium‑phosphide semiconductors, optical fiber and silicon‑photonics, with representative companies including Fujikura, Sumitomo Electric Industries, Furukawa Electric, Hamamatsu Photonics, Mitsubishi Electric and Hitachi High‑Tech.

Some of Lumentum’s technology comes from Japan, as the company acquired Oclaro in 2018, which had taken over Hitachi’s optical research results. Lumentum’s plant in Sagamihara, Japan, is now one of the world’s most advanced indium‑phosphide component production sites, capable of reliably supplying high‑quality products.

Earlier this year, Israeli silicon‑photonics wafer foundry Tower Semiconductor acquired control of a 300‑mm wafer fab in Uozu, Toyama Prefecture, Japan, and plans to expand its photonics product shipments.

items.title_en: Musk Approves Tesla and SpaceX to Lead Terafab, Planning Over $100 Billion Chip Investment
paras: 2026年10月09日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 特斯拉Tesla(TSLA-US)執行長馬斯克明確表示，Terafab半導體計畫將由特斯拉與SpaceX共同持有並負責營運，而非交由外部晶圓代工廠主導。消息帶動特斯拉週五盤前股價上漲約1%，報379美元。
Terafab預計落腳美國德州，整體投資規模將超過1,000億美元，首階段投入約100億至200億美元，由特斯拉與SpaceX共同出資。馬斯克規劃最終建置面積達1億平方英尺的半導體園區，整合晶片製造、先進封裝、組裝及測試，規模約為特斯拉德州電動車超級工廠的10倍，也是台積電目前亞利桑那州晶圓廠的30倍。
馬斯克認為，半導體供應能力將成為AI發展的重要瓶頸，因此希望透過自建產能，支援特斯拉自動駕駛、Robotaxi及人形機器人等業務需求。目前英特爾Intel(INTC-US)與台積電(2330-TW)均參與相關合作，但馬斯克強調，Terafab的所有權與營運權仍由特斯拉及SpaceX掌握，台積電等合作夥伴未來可選擇租用廠區空間。
市場預期，特斯拉將在10月21日公布第三季財報時進一步說明Terafab進度。華爾街目前預估第三季營收為283億美元，高於去年同期的281億美元，但每股盈餘預估為0.45美元，低於去年同期的0.50美元。Tigress Financial則維持特斯拉買進評等，目標價550美元，看好其AI、自動駕駛及機器人業務的長期發展。

paras_en: October 9, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center) – Tesla (TSLA-US) CEO Elon Musk said clearly that the Terafab semiconductor project will be jointly owned and operated by Tesla and SpaceX, rather than being handed over to an external foundry. The news lifted Tesla's pre‑market price on Friday by about 1%, to $379.

Terafab is expected to be located in Texas, with a total investment exceeding $100 billion. The first phase will involve an outlay of roughly $10 billion to $20 billion, funded jointly by Tesla and SpaceX. Musk envisions a final semiconductor campus of 100 million square feet, integrating chip fabrication, advanced packaging, assembly and testing. The site would be about ten times the size of Tesla’s Texas Gigafactory and thirty times the size of TSMC’s current Arizona fab.

Musk believes semiconductor supply will become a critical bottleneck for AI development, so he wants to build capacity in‑house to support Tesla’s autonomous driving, Robotaxi and humanoid robot businesses. Intel (INTC-US) and TSMC (2330‑TW) are already involved in related collaborations, but Musk stressed that ownership and operational control of Terafab will remain with Tesla and SpaceX, with partners like TSMC able to lease space in the facility if they wish.

Wall Street currently forecasts Q3 revenue of $28.3 billion, up from $28.1 billion a year ago, but EPS is projected at $0.45, down from $0.50 a year ago. items.title: OpenAI營收疑雲釐清後 AI晶片股仍震盪 輝達、美光收低
items.title_en: OpenAI Revenue Uncertainty Clarified, AI Chip Stocks Remain Volatile as Nvidia and Micron Slip
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，儘管投資人對OpenAI的財務狀況似乎有了更明確了解，但市場對晶片股的態度再度轉趨謹慎。
OpenAI是觀察AI晶片需求是否持續的重要指標，也能反映AI基礎設施的投資支出。因此，輝達(Nvidia)(NVDA-US)、美光(Micron)(MU-US)及其他AI重量級企業的投資人，都密切關注與ChatGPT開發商財務有關的各項數據。
根據《金融時報》周四報導，OpenAI告訴投資人，截至上月底，其年化營收接近500億美元。這項數字比OpenAI先前提出的約700億美元預估少了200億美元。消息傳出後，晶片股遭到拋售。
然而，《彭博社》周五報導，OpenAI預期到今年底，年化淨營收將達到700億美元，主要動能來自企業業務的強勁表現。據報導，截至9月底，OpenAI的年化營收約為500億美元。年化營收是將某個月份或其他較短期間的營收，換算成全年規模，以估算公司在一整年內可能創造的營收。
這項較為樂觀的展望，帶動輝達、美光及其他晶片股周五稍早上漲，但這些股票隨後回落。輝達與美光股價收盤均小幅下跌，SanDisk則下跌1.7%。
另一方面，正與這家AI新創公司合作設計客製化晶片的博通(Broadcom)(AVGO-US)，股價小幅上漲。
由於OpenAI是一家未上市公司，沒有義務公開財務表現，投資人往往只能透過新聞報導中的資訊，試圖拼湊出財務狀況。另一個讓OpenAI財務狀況難以評估的原因，是它採用的營收指標可能與Anthropic不同。
《金融時報》指出，OpenAI投資人據報曾試圖將其年化營收與競爭對手Anthropic進行比較，但由於兩家先進AI實驗室計算這項數字的方式不同，導致比較結果出現不一致。
《金融時報》與《彭博社》均報導，Anthropic會將部分銷售的總額納入計算，例如透過雲端合作夥伴產生的銷售額，OpenAI則只計入與雲端服務供應商合作所產生營收中，實際歸屬自己的部分。
Jefferies股票交易分析師Jeffrey Favuzza在周五給客戶的報告中表示，儘管市場上許多人已經理解淨額與總額之間的差異，「這仍是一個預期管理問題，因為媒體過去一直以『淨營收』的角度報導與討論OpenAI的營收年化推算值」。
展望未來，Favuzza表示，一旦至少有一家AI領導企業上市，市場很可能會「非常興奮」，因為公開上市將讓投資人更透明地掌握企業的實際財務數據。
paras_en: MarketWatch reported that although investors seem to have a clearer picture of OpenAI’s financial situation, the market’s stance on chip stocks has turned cautious again.

OpenAI is a key gauge of whether AI chip demand will persist and reflects investment spending on AI infrastructure. Consequently, investors in Nvidia (NVDA-US), Micron (MU-US) and other heavyweight AI companies are closely watching any data related to the finances of the ChatGPT developer.

According to the Financial Times on Thursday, OpenAI told investors that as of the end of last month its annualized revenue was close to $50 billion. This figure is $20 billion less than the roughly $70 billion estimate the company had previously floated, and the news triggered a sell‑off in chip stocks.

However, Bloomberg reported on Friday that OpenAI expects its annualized net revenue to reach $70 billion by year‑end, driven mainly by strong enterprise business performance. The report said that as of the end of September OpenAI’s annualized revenue was about $50 billion. Annualized revenue converts a month or other short‑term figure to a full‑year scale to estimate what the company could generate over a year.

The more optimistic outlook lifted Nvidia, Micron and other chip stocks early on Friday, but the shares later gave back the gains. Nvidia and Micron both closed with modest declines, while SanDisk fell 1.7%.
On the other hand, Broadcom (AVGO-US), which is working with the AI startup to design custom chips, saw its stock tick up slightly.

Because OpenAI is a private company, it has no obligation to disclose its financial performance, so investors must piece together information from news reports to gauge its finances. Another reason its financial picture is hard to assess is that its revenue metric may differ from that used by Anthropic.

The Financial Times noted that OpenAI investors reportedly tried to compare its annualized revenue with rival Anthropic’s, but the two advanced AI labs calculate the figure differently, leading to inconsistent comparisons.

Both the Financial Times and Bloomberg reported that Anthropic includes the total amount of certain sales—such as revenue generated through cloud partners—while OpenAI only counts the portion of cloud‑service‑partner revenue that is actually attributable to itself.

Jefferies equity analyst Jeffrey Favuzza wrote in a Friday client note that although many market participants now understand the difference between net and gross figures, “this is still an expectations‑management issue because the media has historically reported and discussed OpenAI’s annualized revenue from a ‘net revenue’ perspective.”

Looking ahead, Favuzza said that once at least one leading AI company goes public, the market is likely to become “very excited,” as a public listing would give investors far more transparent access to the firm’s actual financial data.

items.title_en: New York FX Market: Dollar Rises for Fourth Consecutive Week as Oil Prices Climb, Suppressing Euro’s Five‑Week Decline
paras: 美元周五(9日)上漲，歐元則連續第五周下跌。隨著油價回升、抹去稍早跌幅，歐元早盤漲勢逐漸消退。不過，由於法國陷入困境的公債市場趨於穩定，歐元近期的賣壓有所緩和。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.13%，報102.25。美元指數本周上漲約0.3%，連續第四周走高，寫下2025年5月以來最長連漲紀錄。
本周一，歐元兌美元一度跌至1.1161美元，創17個月新低。投資人憂心法國公共債務創下歷史新高，且政府削減預算支出的政治之路困難重重。相較之下，美國經濟與美元則顯得相對強勁。
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1.1198美元，本周累計下跌約0.5%，創下2025年初以來兌美元連續周線下跌最長紀錄。
法國與義大利公債的風險溢價本周有望下滑。這些溢價在9月下旬曾大幅攀升，但隨著投資人等待新的局勢發展，再決定是否要求更高的報酬，以補償財政與政治風險，近期風險溢價已逐步回落。
川普暗示不會攻擊伊朗
周五稍早，全球債券市場趨於平靜。美國總統川普表示，美國不會在11月3日美國期中選舉前攻擊伊朗，並稱美國與德黑蘭當局就戰事進行了富有成果的談判。受此消息影響，油價稍早下跌。
Moneycorp交易與結構型產品主管Eugene Epstein表示，「目前有多項因素同時發揮影響，包括油價走高，以及法國的問題，因此很難判斷究竟是哪一項因素對市場的影響更大。」
「但實際來看，我認為今天市場相對處於觀望狀態。所有人都在等待聯準會(Fed)官員的談話陸續釋出，因為現在可以明顯看出，美元對各位聯準會官員的談話都相當敏感。」
然而，隨著英國海軍相關機構英國海事貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)表示，一艘船隻在阿拉伯聯合大公國半島以西13海浬處遭不明飛行物擊中，原油價格隨後自低點反彈。
美國原油上漲0.6%，報每桶92.04美元，盤中最低曾跌至90.01美元。布蘭特原油則上漲0.58%，報每桶104.88美元，稍早最低曾跌至102.33美元。
全球各地債券殖利率近幾周持續攀升，原因包括市場預期各國央行將升息，以及對政府財政狀況的憂慮。
央行政策成焦點
儘管近期經濟數據顯示通膨壓力持續存在，市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍相對有限。
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預估，聯準會本月升息至少1碼的機率為19.4%，不過，市場認為12月會議升息的機率高達85.8%。
周五公布的密西根大學消費者調查顯示，由於中東衝突推升生活成本，美國10月初的消費者信心進一步下滑，家庭對經濟前景的看法也因此轉趨悲觀。
儘管多位聯準會官員表示，為了抑制通膨，未來仍有必要進一步升息，但也有官員反對立即升息，並指出聯準會應保持耐心與彈性，再決定未來的利率走向。
法國公債持續承壓，政界人士難以在2027年一場充滿分歧的選舉前有效削減預算赤字。本周稍早，西班牙宣布提前舉行大選，也進一步增加歐元的壓力。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.08%，至1.3235美元，但連續第七周下跌，為2024年11月以來最長連跌紀錄。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 9th), while the euro fell for a fifth straight week. As oil prices recovered, erasing earlier losses, the euro’s early‑session gains gradually faded. However, with France’s troubled sovereign‑bond market stabilising, selling pressure on the euro has eased somewhat recently.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.13% to 102.25. The index is up about 0.3% this week, marking a fourth consecutive week of gains and the longest winning streak since May 2025.

On Monday, the euro slipped to $1.1161, a 17‑month low. Investors worry that France’s public debt has hit a historic high and that the political path to cutting budget spending is fraught with difficulty. By contrast, the U.S. economy and the dollar appear relatively strong.
The euro fell 0.1% to $1.1198, down about 0.5% for the week, setting the longest run of weekly declines against the dollar since early 2025.

Risk premiums on French and Italian sovereign bonds are expected to fall this week. Those premiums surged in late September, but as investors await new developments and decide whether higher compensation is needed for fiscal and political risk, the premiums have been gradually retreating.
Trump hints he will not attack Iran

Earlier on Friday, global bond markets steadied. U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States will not attack Iran before the November 3 mid‑term elections and claimed that the U.S. and Tehran had productive war‑related talks. The news knocked oil prices lower earlier in the session.

Eugene Epstein, head of transactions and structured products at Moneycorp, said, “There are several factors at play right now, including rising oil prices and France’s issues, so it’s hard to pinpoint which factor is having the bigger market impact.”

“In reality, I think the market is in a wait‑and‑see mode today. Everyone is waiting for Fed officials’ remarks to roll out, because it’s clear the dollar is very sensitive to whatever the Fed speakers say,” he added.

However, the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that a vessel 13 nautical miles west of the UAE peninsula was struck by an unidentified flying object, after which crude oil prices rebounded from their lows.
U.S. crude rose 0.6% to $92.04 a barrel, after dipping to a intraday low of $90.01. Brent crude gained 0.58% to $104.88, after an earlier low of $102.33.
Bond yields around the world have been climbing for several weeks, driven by expectations of rate hikes by central banks and concerns over sovereign fiscal health.
Central‑bank policy is in focus
Even though recent economic data show persistent inflation pressure, market expectations for a rate hike at this month’s Fed policy meeting remain relatively modest.

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 19.4% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least one basis point this month, while the odds of a hike at the December meeting are as high as 85.8%.

A Michigan University consumer survey released on Friday showed that, as Middle‑East conflict pushes up living costs, U.S. consumer confidence slipped further in early October and households grew more pessimistic about the economic outlook.

While several Fed officials have said further rate hikes may be needed to curb inflation, some have opposed an immediate increase, arguing the Fed should stay patient and flexible before deciding the future rate path.

French sovereign bonds remain under pressure, and politicians find it hard to meaningfully cut the budget deficit before a divisive 2027 election. Earlier this week, Spain announced an early election, adding further pressure on the euro.
The pound rose 0.08% to $1.3235 against the dollar but has been falling for a seventh consecutive week, the longest streak of declines since November 2024.
The dollar gained 0.25% against the yen to ¥158.25. The yen may be on track for a fourth straight week of weakness, down about 0.2% for the week.

items.title: 伊朗戰火再起？川普改口「選前動武」仍有可能
items.title_en: Iran Conflict Rekindles? Trump Reverses Stance, Says Pre‑Election Strike Still Possible
paras: 多家媒體報導，美國總統川普週五 (9 日) 被媒體問及，為何不立即對伊朗採取軍事行動，而要等到期中選舉之後時，他改口稱：「我們可能會。」川普此前曾表示，美國不會在 11 月期中選舉前攻擊伊朗，但最新回應再度為選前動武留下可能性，並未說明具體行動時程。
《Axios》週四 (8 日) 引述美方及以色列官員消息指出，美國國防部已於數日前指示中央司令部 (CENTCOM)，完成重啟對伊朗大規模軍事行動的準備。不過，川普尚未做出最終決定。
美方與以色列消息人士透露，軍事行動仍可能在美國期中選舉，以及提前一週舉行的以色列大選之前展開。若戰事重啟，美軍預計將大規模轟炸伊朗的能源、基礎建設及核子設施。報導分析，未來數週若爆發戰事，可能推升國際油價，進而影響美國期中選舉選情。
對此，國防部官員表示：「國防部的職責，就是向總統提供各種軍事選項。」
白宮官員則強調，川普掌握局勢主導權，並稱：「美軍已實質掌控荷姆茲海峽，伊朗經濟正面臨崩潰。伊朗已遭重創，接下來可以選擇『簡單』或『艱難』的道路。川普總統掌握所有籌碼，將做出對美國最有利的決定。」
外交方面，美伊談判至今仍未取得進展。由卡達協調的間接談判管道，目前仍在等待德黑蘭回應美方提出的修訂方案，內容要求伊朗在核武發展問題上做出明確讓步。
川普的國家安全團隊上週五 (2 日) 在大衛營 (Camp David) 召開長達數小時的會議。以色列官員透露，重啟對伊朗軍事打擊是討論重點之一；國務卿盧比歐 (Marco Rubio) 則在會後表示，會議主要聚焦於「長期外交政策規劃」。
另一名以色列官員表示：「關於重啟大規模軍事行動的討論明顯增加。雖然選前發動打擊的機率不算高，但仍無法排除；期中選舉結束後，發動攻擊的可能性將大幅提升。」
與此同時，美以高層近期再度密集聯繫。川普週三與以色列總理尼坦雅胡 (Benjamin Netanyahu) 通話，這是兩人近期第二次通話，結束先前長達數週的互動冷淡期。美方官員透露，通話內容包括悼念「10 月 7 日大屠殺」受害者。
據報導，這場通話是在尼坦雅胡與國安團隊召開伊朗局勢專案會議後進行。尼坦雅胡此前也於週一與盧比歐通話。消息人士指出，若美軍重啟對伊朗的軍事行動，很可能與以色列國防軍 (IDF) 聯合作戰。
兩名以色列官員另警告，伊朗政權目前高度焦慮，對再次遭突襲抱持強烈戒心。在接連遭受兩次先發制人的攻擊後，德黑蘭正設法避免第三次陷入被動，因此不排除伊朗可能率先採取軍事行動。
paras_en: Multiple media outlets reported that when asked on Friday (the 9th) why he was not taking immediate military action against Iran and instead waiting until after the midterm elections, President Trump changed his answer to: “We might.” Trump had previously said the United States would not attack Iran before the November midterms, but his latest response leaves open the possibility of a pre‑election strike, without specifying a timeline for any action.

Axios quoted U.S. and Israeli officials on Thursday (the 8th) saying the Department of Defense had instructed CENTCOM a few days earlier to complete preparations for a large‑scale military operation against Iran. However, Trump has not yet made a final decision.

U.S. and Israeli sources said the operation could still be launched before the U.S. midterms and a week before Israel’s election. If hostilities resume, U.S. forces are expected to bomb Iran’s energy, infrastructure and nuclear facilities on a massive scale. Analysts note that a war in the coming weeks could push up global oil prices and affect the U.S. midterm election outlook.
A Defense Department official said, “The Department’s job is to provide the president with a range of military options.”

White House officials stressed that Trump controls the situation, stating, “The U.S. military has effectively taken control of the Hormuz Strait, and Iran’s economy is on the brink of collapse. Iran has been severely damaged and now faces a ‘simple’ or ‘hard’ path. President Trump holds all the cards and will make the decision that is best for the United States.”

Diplomatically, U.S.–Iran talks have made no progress. The indirect negotiation channel coordinated by Qatar is still waiting for Tehran to respond to a revised U.S. proposal that demands clear concessions from Iran on its nuclear weapons development.

Trump’s national security team held a several‑hour meeting at Camp David last Friday (the 2nd). Israeli officials said the resumption of military strikes against Iran was a key topic, and Secretary of State Marco Rubio said after the meeting that the discussion focused on “long‑term diplomatic policy planning.”

Another Israeli official said, “Discussions about restarting a large‑scale military operation have clearly increased. While the odds of a pre‑election strike are not high, they cannot be ruled out; the likelihood of an attack after the midterms will rise sharply.”

At the same time, senior U.S. and Israeli officials have been in frequent contact again. Trump spoke with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu on Wednesday, their second call in recent days, ending a weeks‑long period of cool interaction. U.S. officials said the call included condolences for the victims of the October 7 massacre.

According to reports, the call took place after Netanyahu and his security team held a special meeting on the Iran situation. Netanyahu had also spoken with Rubio on Monday. Sources said that if the U.S. resumes military action against Iran, it will likely be conducted jointly with the Israel Defense Forces.

Two Israeli officials warned that Iran’s regime is currently highly anxious and extremely wary of another surprise attack. After suffering two pre‑emptive strikes, Tehran is trying to avoid a third passive setback and does not rule out the possibility of taking the initiative first.

paras: 投資人逐漸消化 OpenAI 年化營收消息，並將目光轉向下週大型銀行財報，美股週五 (9 日) 幾乎全面收高，軟體與醫療保健類股領漲，標普 500 指數逼近歷史高點。道瓊收漲逾 420 點，僅費半仍收黑約 0.4%。
三大指數本週均收紅，道瓊累計上漲約 0.9%，那斯達克升約 0.6%，標普週漲約 1.2%。

美國總統川普週五表示，俄羅斯總統普丁已同意向美國及全球市場供應柴油，俄羅斯已同意向美國及全球市場供應超過480萬噸柴油，其中首批逾30萬噸將立即交付，後續還有數百萬噸的供應計畫。
消息傳出後，美股隨後攀抵當日高點，柴油期貨明顯下跌，原油自高位回落。週五西德州原油期貨仍收漲約 0.39%，報每桶 91.85 美元，布蘭特原油則收在每桶 104 美元以上。
美股週五 (9 日) 主要指數表現：
NYSE FANG+ 指數中的科技五大巨頭漲跌互見。Meta (META-US) 下跌 0.31%；蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 1.11%；Alphabet (GOOGL-US) 上漲 0.97%；微軟 (MSFT-US) 上漲 2.38%；亞馬遜 (AMZN-US) 上漲 3.29%。
半導體焦點個股多數收黑。AMD (AMD-US) 下跌 2.03%；博通 (AVGO-US) 上漲 0.39%；輝達 (NVDA-US) 下跌 0.52%；應用材料 (AMAT-US) 下跌 0.50%；高通 (QCOM-US) 下跌 0.29%。
記憶體與儲存族群漲跌不一。美光 (MU-US) 下跌 0.66%；威騰電子 (WDC-US) 上漲 1.01%；SanDisk (SNDK-US) 下跌 1.72%；希捷 (STX-US) 上漲 1.06%；SK 海力士 ADR (SKHY-US) 下跌 0.86%。
台股 ADR 互有消長。台積電 ADR (TSM-US) 下跌 1.02%；日月光 ADR (ASX-US) 上漲 2.59%；聯電 ADR (UMC-US) 上漲 0.61%；中華電信 ADR (CHT-US) 下跌 0.45%。
企業新聞
SpaceX (SPCX-US) 向 Grain Management 達成收購頻譜協議，並表示這筆交易將「為 Starlink Mobile 成為美國主要行動電信業者鋪路」，美國電信股週五倒成一片。
AT&T (T-US) 崩跌近 9.9%，Verizon (VZ-US) 暴跌近 8.8%，T-Mobile US (TMUS-US) 更狂瀉約 13.3%。
不過，花旗分析師 Michael Rollins 認為，投資人可考慮逢低買進，這些業者未來一年仍有上漲空間。
基地台鐵塔業者股價歡漲。American Tower (AMT-US) 噴高 9.3%，Crown Castle (CCI-US) 狂飆超 15%，SBA Communications (SBAC-US) 則飛漲 7.3%。
蘋果 (AAPL-US) 下跌 1.1% 至每股 336.64 美元。《日經亞洲》週五報導，由於消費者需求疲弱，蘋果已要求供應商削減 iPhone 18 Pro 與 Pro Max 零組件產量。
達美航空 (DAL-US) 股價幾乎持平，報每股 82.17 美元。伊朗戰爭推升航空燃油價格，導致成本增加，使公司第三季獲利未達分析師預期。
Lumentum Holdings (LITE-US) 勁揚 5.2% 至每股 1,103.36 美元。執行長 Michael Hurlston 週五接受外媒訪問時表示，公司截至 2029 年的光學元件產能幾乎已被預訂一空，並且到明年為止，部分產品的需求可能有高達 70% 無法獲得滿足。
華爾街分析
Edwards Asset Management 執行長 Bob Edwards 表示，企業獲利依然強勁。儘管地緣政治衝突、殖利率上升、AI 疑慮及 11 月期中選舉可能造成波動，隨著不確定性消退，投資人將重新聚焦獲利成長與企業長期基本面。
Nationwide 市場策略師 Mark Hackett 指出，企業獲利與 AI 投資仍是成長股的重要支柱，但長天期美債殖利率偏高、能源帶動的通膨風險，以及漲勢集中於少數個股，都讓市場更難承受不如預期的消息。
Vital Knowledge 分析師 Adam Crisafulli 則提醒，近期 AI 股賣壓反映市場部位過度集中，調整可能尚未結束，因此整體 AI 科技股未必能迅速出現 V 型反彈。相較於營收計算方式的差異，他更關注獨立 AI 開發商的商業吸引力，以及市場對大量 AI 相關債券與股權融資的承受能力。
下週除財報外，關鍵通膨數據也將牽動利率預期。美債現貨市場下週一因哥倫布日休市。

paras_en: Investors are gradually digesting OpenAI’s annual revenue news and shifting focus to next week’s major bank earnings reports. U.S. stocks closed almost uniformly higher on Friday (9th), with software and healthcare stocks leading the gains and the S&P 500 approaching a historic high. The Dow rose more than 420 points, while the Nasdaq gained about 0.4% and the S&P 500 climbed roughly 0.4%.
All three major indices ended the week in the green; the Dow had a cumulative gain of about 0.9%, the Nasdaq rose about 0.6%, and the S&P 500 increased about 1.2% for the week.

The U.S. 10‑year Treasury yield rose 2 basis points to 5.25% on Friday. The dollar index has risen for four consecutive weeks, marking the longest streak of gains since May 2025. Spot gold climbed about 1.5%, trading at $4,194.43 per ounce.

U.S. President Trump announced on Friday that Russian President Putin has agreed to supply diesel to the United States and global markets. Russia has agreed to supply more than 4.8 million tonnes of diesel, with the first shipment of over 300,000 tonnes to be delivered immediately and additional millions of tonnes planned thereafter.

Following the news, U.S. stocks surged to the day's high, diesel futures fell noticeably, and crude oil retraced from its highs. West Texas Intermediate crude still closed higher by about 0.39% at $91.85 per barrel, while Brent crude closed above $104 per barrel.
U.S. stocks on Friday (9th) saw the following major index performances:

The Dow Jones Industrial Average rose 423.31 points, or 0.83%, to 51,654.95. The Nasdaq Composite rose 172.83 points, or 0.64%, to 27,366.17. The S&P 500 rose 46.18 points, or 0.59%, to 7,811.54. The Philadelphia Semiconductor Index fell 51.29 points, or 0.41%, to 12,572.42. The NYSE FANG+ Index rose 162.21 points, or 0.83%, to 19,589.70.

In the NYSE FANG+ Index, the five tech giants moved in different directions: Meta (META‑US) fell 0.31%; Apple (AAPL‑US) fell 1.11%; Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) rose 0.97%; Microsoft (MSFT‑US) rose 2.38%; and Amazon (AMZN‑US) rose 3.29%.

Most semiconductor focus stocks closed lower: AMD (AMD‑US) fell 2.03%; Broadcom (AVGO‑US) rose 0.39%; NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) fell 0.52%; Applied Materials (AMAT‑US) fell 0.50%; Qualcomm (QCOM‑US) fell 0.29%.

Memory and storage stocks had mixed results: Micron (MU‑US) fell 0.66%; Western Digital (WDC‑US) rose 1.01%; SanDisk (SNDK‑US) fell 1.72%; Seagate (STX‑US) rose 1.06%; SK Hynix ADR (SKHY‑US) fell 0.86%.
Taiwan ADRs had mixed performance: TSMC ADR (TSM‑US) fell 1.02%; ASE ADR (ASX‑US) rose 2.59%; UMC ADR (UMC‑US) rose 0.61%; Chunghwa Telecom ADR (CHT‑US) fell 0.45%.
Corporate news:

SpaceX (SPCX‑US) reached a spectrum acquisition agreement with Grain Management and said the deal would pave the way for Starlink Mobile to become a major U.S. mobile telecom provider, causing U.S. telecom stocks to tumble on Friday.
AT&T (T‑US) plunged nearly 9.9%, Verizon (VZ‑US) fell almost 8.8%, and T‑Mobile US (TMUS‑US) crashed about 13.3%.
However, Citi analyst Michael Rollins believes investors could consider buying on dips, as these carriers still have upside potential over the next year.
Tower‑operator stocks surged: American Tower (AMT‑US) jumped 9.3%, Crown Castle (CCI‑US) surged over 15%, and SBA Communications (SBAC‑US) rose 7.3%.
Apple (AAPL‑US) fell 1.1% to $336.64 per share. Nikkei Asia reported on Friday that due to weak consumer demand, Apple has asked suppliers to cut iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max component production.
Delta Air Lines (DAL‑US) held steady at $82.17 per share. The Iran conflict has pushed jet fuel prices higher, increasing costs and causing the company’s Q3 earnings to miss analyst expectations.

Lumentum Holdings (LITE‑US) surged 5.2% to $1,103.36 per share. CEO Michael Hurlston told foreign media on Friday that the company’s optical component capacity is almost fully booked through 2029, and that some products may face up to 70% unmet demand by next year.
Wall Street analysts:

Edwards Asset Management CEO Bob Edwards said corporate earnings remain strong. Despite geopolitical tensions, rising yields, AI concerns, and the November midterm election potentially causing volatility, investors will refocus on earnings growth and long‑term fundamentals as uncertainty eases.

Nationwide market strategist Mark Hackett noted that corporate earnings and AI investment remain key growth drivers, but long‑term U.S. Treasury yields are high, energy‑driven inflation risk exists, and the rally is concentrated in a few stocks, making the market more vulnerable to disappointing news.

Vital Knowledge analyst Adam Crisafulli warned that recent AI stock selling pressure reflects over‑concentration of positions, and that a full correction may not yet be finished, so AI tech stocks may not see a rapid V‑shape rebound. Compared to revenue calculation differences, he focuses more on the commercial attractiveness of independent AI developers and the market’s capacity to absorb large amounts of AI‑related bond and equity financing.
Next week, aside from earnings, key inflation data will also influence rate expectations. U.S. Treasury spot markets will be closed on Monday due to Columbus Day.

items.title: 巴拿馬規模7.7強震催毀民宅 引發海嘯警報
items.title_en: Panama's Magnitude 7.7 Quake Destroys Homes, Triggers Tsunami Warning
paras: 多家外媒報導，巴拿馬於台灣時間週六(10日)凌晨1時56分 (當地時間10月9日中午12時56分) 發生規模7.7強震，震源深度為12.6公里，首都巴拿馬市建築物明顯搖晃，部分建築物受損，居民與上班族撤離至戶外，鄰國哥倫比亞也感受到震動，所幸全球貿易重要水道巴拿馬運河的運作未影響。
美國地質調查所(USGS)指出，震央位於中部埃雷拉省(Herrera)偏遠社區皮塔洛薩阿里巴(Pitaloza Arriba)西南方約10公里，震源深度為10公里。地震規模最初公布為8.0，隨後下修至7.6，再修正為7.7。
主震後餘震接連發生，USGS記錄到其中2起規模分別為5.8及5.5。
美國國家氣象局(NWS)週五對巴拿馬、哥倫比亞、厄瓜多、尼加拉瓜及瓜地馬拉沿岸發布海嘯警報。
由於如此強度的地震在巴拿馬相當罕見，隨著一連串較弱的餘震持續撼動當地，部分年長居民在街頭驚嚇落淚。
目擊者表示，遠至鄰國哥斯大黎加首都聖荷西，也能感受到震動。
巴拿馬總統穆里諾(José Raúl Mulino)則在社群平台X呼籲民眾保持冷靜，表示不應利用此次事件引發驚慌或混亂。
巴拿馬國家民防機構官員史密斯(Omar Smith)表示，災損集中在貝拉瓜斯省(Veraguas)、埃雷拉省及洛斯桑托斯省(Los Santos)。
截稿前，中部科克萊省(Coclé)佩諾諾梅市(Penonomé)一座天主教主教座堂倒塌，另有一家飯店的部分外牆掉落，砸中一輛汽車。民防機構表示，正調查震央附近地區可能出現的災損。
巴拿馬位於環太平洋火山帶。這條環繞太平洋盆地、由火山與斷層構成的帶狀區域長約40,000公里，全球多數地震發生於此。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media reported that Panama experienced a magnitude‑7.7 earthquake at 1:56 a.m. Taiwan time on Saturday (October 10), which was 12:56 p.m. local time on October 9. The quake’s hypocenter was 12.6 km deep, buildings in the capital Panama City swayed noticeably, some were damaged, and residents and office workers evacuated outdoors. Neighboring Colombia also felt the shaking, but the crucial global trade route, the Panama Canal, remained operational.

The U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) said the epicenter was about 10 km southwest of the remote community of Pitaloza Arriba in Herrera Province, with a hypocenter depth of 10 km. The quake was initially reported as magnitude 8.0, then revised to 7.6, and finally to 7.7.
After the main shock, aftershocks followed in quick succession, with the USGS recording two of them at magnitudes 5.8 and 5.5 respectively.
The U.S. National Weather Service (NWS) on Friday issued tsunami warnings for the coasts of Panama, Colombia, Ecuador, Nicaragua and Guatemala.

Because an earthquake of this strength is very rare in Panama, a series of weaker aftershocks continued to shake the area, causing some elderly residents to break down in tears on the streets out of fright.
Witnesses said that the tremor was felt as far away as San José, the capital of neighboring Costa Rica.
Panama’s President José Raúl Mulino used the social platform X to urge the public to stay calm, saying the event should not be exploited to cause panic or disorder.
Omar Smith, an official of Panama’s National Civil Defense Agency, said the damage was concentrated in Veraguas Province, Herrera Province and Los Santos Province.

Before the deadline, a Catholic cathedral in Penonomé, Coclé Province collapsed, and part of a hotel’s exterior wall fell, striking a car. The civil defense agency said it is investigating possible damage in areas near the epicenter.
Panama lies on the Pacific Ring of Fire, a belt of volcanoes and faults that circles the Pacific basin for about 40,000 km and is where most of the world’s earthquakes occur.

items.title: 美國今年當G20主席國 財長貝森特卻缺席IMF與世銀年會
items.title_en: U.S. Serves as G20 Chair This Year, but Treasury Secretary Borenstein Skips IMF and World Bank Annual Meetings
paras: 美國財政部長貝森特將缺席下周在泰國曼谷舉行的國際貨幣基金(IMF)與世界銀行年會。美方官員周五(9日)表示，原因是國內行程安排，但未說明具體事項。此時美債殖利率已攀抵近25年高點，中東戰爭引發的能源衝擊也拖累全球成長，讓他的缺席格外受到關注。
據《路透》報導，美國財政部證實，將由副部長布魯克(Francis Brooke)與主管國際事務的次長布朗(Erin Browne)率領財政部代表團，與各國討論多項迫切經濟議題。
財政部表示，美方將與夥伴合作，處理阻礙成長的政策及結構性失衡，並推動更透明、有效的主權債務處理方式，協助陷入債務困境的國家恢復穩定與成長，同時要求債權人及借款國遵循明確、一致的標準。
美國今年擔任二十國集團(G20)主席國，貝森特原本通常應主持各國財長與央行首長會議。他預計仍將出席12月在佛羅里達州邁阿密舉行的G20領袖峰會。
高階官員因行程等因素偶爾缺席國際會議並非罕見，但各國官員通常會利用年會，與美國財長安排正式或非正式雙邊會談，因此貝森特缺席可能令其他代表失望。美國期中選舉逼近，他近期也是政府國內經濟政策的重要發言人。
貝森特去年也曾缺席南非G20會議，當時川普政府反對南非土地改革等政策。
財政部另表示，美國身為IMF與世界銀行最大股東，將持續要求兩機構聚焦核心任務、提升運作效率，支持有助經濟穩定、生產力與成長的政策。美方強調，此次曼谷行程的明確目標，是確保國際金融機構與整體國際經濟體系，促進美國經濟及國家安全利益。
paras_en: U.S. Treasury Secretary Borenstein will miss next week’s International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank annual meetings in Bangkok, Thailand. U.S. officials said on Friday (the 9th) that the absence is due to a domestic schedule, without specifying the exact commitments. The move draws extra attention as U.S. Treasury yields have risen to near‑25‑year highs and the energy shock from the Middle‑East war is weighing on global growth.

According to Reuters, the U.S. Treasury confirmed that Deputy Secretary Francis Brooke and Undersecretary for International Affairs Erin Browne will lead the Treasury delegation to discuss a range of urgent economic issues with other countries.

The Treasury said the United States will work with partners to address policy and structural imbalances that hinder growth, and to promote a more transparent and effective approach to sovereign debt management that helps debt‑troubled nations regain stability and growth, while requiring creditors and borrowers to follow clear, consistent standards.

The United States is this year’s chair of the Group of Twenty (G20). Borenstein would normally chair meetings of finance ministers and central bank governors. He is still expected to attend the G20 leaders’ summit in Miami, Florida, in December.

It is not unusual for senior officials to miss international conferences due to scheduling conflicts, but ministers typically use the annual meetings to arrange formal or informal bilateral talks with the U.S. Treasury chief, so Borenstein’s absence may disappoint other delegations. With the U.S. mid‑term elections approaching, he has also been a key spokesperson on domestic economic policy.
Borenstein also missed last year’s G20 meeting in South Africa, when the Trump administration opposed South Africa’s land‑reform policies.

The Treasury added that, as the largest shareholder of the IMF and World Bank, the United States will continue to press the two institutions to focus on their core missions, improve operational efficiency, and support policies that foster economic stability, productivity and growth. The U.S. emphasized that the clear objective of the Bangkok trip is to ensure that international financial institutions and the broader global economic system advance U.S. economic and national‑security interests.

paras: 美元周五(9日)上漲，歐元則連續第五周下跌。隨著油價回升、抹去稍早跌幅，歐元早盤漲勢逐漸消退。不過，由於法國陷入困境的公債市場趨於穩定，歐元近期的賣壓有所緩和。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.13%，報102.25。美元指數本周上漲約0.3%，連續第四周走高，寫下2025年5月以來最長連漲紀錄。
本周一，歐元兌美元一度跌至1.1161美元，創17個月新低。投資人憂心法國公共債務創下歷史新高，且政府削減預算支出的政治之路困難重重。相較之下，美國經濟與美元則顯得相對強勁。
歐元兌美元下跌0.1%，至1.1198美元，本周累計下跌約0.5%，創下2025年初以來兌美元連續周線下跌最長紀錄。
法國與義大利公債的風險溢價本周有望下滑。這些溢價在9月下旬曾大幅攀升，但隨著投資人等待新的局勢發展，再決定是否要求更高的報酬，以補償財政與政治風險，近期風險溢價已逐步回落。
川普暗示不會攻擊伊朗
周五稍早，全球債券市場趨於平靜。美國總統川普表示，美國不會在11月3日美國期中選舉前攻擊伊朗，並稱美國與德黑蘭當局就戰事進行了富有成果的談判。受此消息影響，油價稍早下跌。
Moneycorp交易與結構型產品主管Eugene Epstein表示，「目前有多項因素同時發揮影響，包括油價走高，以及法國的問題，因此很難判斷究竟是哪一項因素對市場的影響更大。」
「但實際來看，我認為今天市場相對處於觀望狀態。所有人都在等待聯準會(Fed)官員的談話陸續釋出，因為現在可以明顯看出，美元對各位聯準會官員的談話都相當敏感。」
然而，隨著英國海軍相關機構英國海事貿易行動辦公室(UKMTO)表示，一艘船隻在阿拉伯聯合大公國半島以西13海浬處遭不明飛行物擊中，原油價格隨後自低點反彈。
美國原油上漲0.6%，報每桶92.04美元，盤中最低曾跌至90.01美元。布蘭特原油則上漲0.58%，報每桶104.88美元，稍早最低曾跌至102.33美元。
全球各地債券殖利率近幾周持續攀升，原因包括市場預期各國央行將升息，以及對政府財政狀況的憂慮。
央行政策成焦點
儘管近期經濟數據顯示通膨壓力持續存在，市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍相對有限。
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預估，聯準會本月升息至少1碼的機率為19.4%，不過，市場認為12月會議升息的機率高達85.8%。
周五公布的密西根大學消費者調查顯示，由於中東衝突推升生活成本，美國10月初的消費者信心進一步下滑，家庭對經濟前景的看法也因此轉趨悲觀。
儘管多位聯準會官員表示，為了抑制通膨，未來仍有必要進一步升息，但也有官員反對立即升息，並指出聯準會應保持耐心與彈性，再決定未來的利率走向。
法國公債持續承壓，政界人士難以在2027年一場充滿分歧的選舉前有效削減預算赤字。本周稍早，西班牙宣布提前舉行大選，也進一步增加歐元的壓力。

paras_en: The dollar rose on Friday (the 9th), while the euro fell for a fifth straight week. As oil prices recovered, erasing earlier losses, the euro’s early‑session gains gradually faded. However, with France’s troubled sovereign‑bond market stabilising, selling pressure on the euro has eased somewhat recently.

In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the greenback against six major currencies, rose 0.13% to 102.25. The index is up about 0.3% this week, marking a fourth consecutive week of gains and the longest winning streak since May 2025.

On Monday, the euro slipped to $1.1161, a 17‑month low. Investors worry that France’s public debt has hit a historic high and that the political path to cutting budget spending is fraught with difficulty. By contrast, the U.S. economy and the dollar appear relatively strong.
The euro fell 0.1% to $1.1198, down about 0.5% for the week, setting the longest run of weekly declines against the dollar since early 2025.

Risk premiums on French and Italian sovereign bonds are expected to fall this week. Those premiums surged in late September, but as investors await new developments and decide whether higher compensation is needed for fiscal and political risk, the premiums have been gradually retreating.
Trump hints he will not attack Iran

Earlier on Friday, global bond markets steadied. U.S. President Donald Trump said the United States will not attack Iran before the November 3 mid‑term elections and claimed that the U.S. and Tehran had productive war‑related talks. The news knocked oil prices lower earlier in the session.

Eugene Epstein, head of transactions and structured products at Moneycorp, said, “There are several factors at play right now, including rising oil prices and France’s issues, so it’s hard to pinpoint which factor is having the bigger market impact.”

“In reality, I think the market is in a wait‑and‑see mode today. Everyone is waiting for Fed officials’ remarks to roll out, because it’s clear the dollar is very sensitive to whatever the Fed speakers say,” he added.

However, the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) reported that a vessel 13 nautical miles west of the UAE peninsula was struck by an unidentified flying object, after which crude oil prices rebounded from their lows.
U.S. crude rose 0.6% to $92.04 a barrel, after dipping to a intraday low of $90.01. Brent crude gained 0.58% to $104.88, after an earlier low of $102.33.
Bond yields around the world have been climbing for several weeks, driven by expectations of rate hikes by central banks and concerns over sovereign fiscal health.
Central‑bank policy is in focus
Even though recent economic data show persistent inflation pressure, market expectations for a rate hike at this month’s Fed policy meeting remain relatively modest.

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 19.4% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least one basis point this month, while the odds of a hike at the December meeting are as high as 85.8%.

A Michigan University consumer survey released on Friday showed that, as Middle‑East conflict pushes up living costs, U.S. consumer confidence slipped further in early October and households grew more pessimistic about the economic outlook.

While several Fed officials have said further rate hikes may be needed to curb inflation, some have opposed an immediate increase, arguing the Fed should stay patient and flexible before deciding the future rate path.

French sovereign bonds remain under pressure, and politicians find it hard to meaningfully cut the budget deficit before a divisive 2027 election. Earlier this week, Spain announced an early election, adding further pressure on the euro.
The pound rose 0.08% to $1.3235 against the dollar but has been falling for a seventh consecutive week, the longest streak of declines since November 2024.
The dollar gained 0.25% against the yen to ¥158.25. The yen may be on track for a fourth straight week of weakness, down about 0.2% for the week.

items.title: 資金急找避風港！全球貨幣市場基金吸金1538億美元 美股基金轉失血
items.title_en: Funds Scramble for Safe Havens! Global Money‑Market Funds Pull in $153.81 Billion, US Equity Funds Turn Red
paras: 全球債市賣壓加劇，美債殖利率攀高與油價居高不下，加深投資人對通膨的疑慮，促使資金轉向避險。根據LSEG Lipper數據，截至10月7日當周，全球貨幣市場基金淨流入1,538.1億美元，創5月6日當周以來最多；美國股票基金則終止連兩周吸金，遭撤資51.1億美元。
標普500指數本周稍早觸及7,844.52點歷史新高，隨後回落。通膨疑慮引發債市拋售，美國10年期公債殖利率攀抵5.3645%，創2002年4月以來新高，壓抑市場情緒，也促使投資人在股市上漲之際獲利了結。
歐洲債務問題同樣牽動市場。法國預算赤字占國內生產毛額(GDP)比重超過5%，加上明年總統大選恐加劇政治分歧，推升其10年期公債殖利率至4.994%，創24年新高。
全球股票基金當周僅淨流入5.6億美元，為近三周最少。歐洲與亞洲股票基金分別吸金61.9億及61.6億美元，美國則出現9月16日當周以來首次淨流出。其中，美國大型、中型及小型股基金分別失血140.8億、10.3億及8.34億美元。
不過，資金並未全面撤離美股。美國產業型基金仍吸金56.8億美元，以科技類股的45.3億美元居首，公用事業與工業類股也分別吸金11.8億及10.4億美元。
債券基金也持續獲資金青睞。全球債券基金淨流入260.3億美元，創7月8日當周以來最多；其中，美國債券基金吸金197.8億美元，創單周紀錄。美國短中期政府債券與公債基金吸金67.6億美元，為六個月最多，短中期投資等級債券基金另吸金50.4億美元。
美國貨幣市場基金則淨流入684.9億美元，扭轉前一周淨流出436億美元的情況。此外，全球黃金及其他貴金屬基金連續第四周吸金，當周流入14.1億美元。新興市場債券基金吸金14.8億美元，股票基金則連續第五周失血，淨流出7.52億美元。
paras_en: Global bond‑market selling pressure intensified, with U.S. Treasury yields climbing and oil prices staying high, deepening investors' inflation concerns and prompting a shift toward safe‑haven assets. According to LSEG Lipper data, in the week to October 7 the net inflow into global money‑market funds was $153.81 billion, the largest since the week of May 6; U.S. equity funds, meanwhile, ended a two‑week inflow streak with a net outflow of $5.11 billion.

The S&P 500 touched a record high of 7,844.52 points earlier this week before pulling back. Inflation worries sparked a bond‑market sell‑off, pushing the 10‑year U.S. Treasury yield to 5.3645%—a peak not seen since April 2002—dampening market sentiment and prompting investors to take profits as equities rose.

Europe's debt issues also weighed on markets. France’s budget deficit exceeds 5% of GDP, and the upcoming presidential election next year could heighten political divisions, lifting its 10‑year sovereign yield to 4.994%, a 24‑year high.

Global equity funds recorded a net inflow of only $560 million for the week, the lowest in nearly three weeks. European and Asian equity funds attracted $6.19 billion and $6.16 billion respectively, while the U.S. saw its first weekly net outflow since the week of September 16. U.S. large‑cap, mid‑cap and small‑cap equity funds lost $14.08 billion, $1.03 billion and $834 million respectively.

Nevertheless, money has not fled U.S. equities entirely. U.S. sector funds still drew $5.68 billion, led by technology funds with $4.53 billion, while utilities and industrials attracted $1.18 billion and $1.04 billion respectively.

Bond funds continued to enjoy inflows. Global bond funds saw a net inflow of $26.03 billion, the highest since the week of July 8; U.S. bond funds alone attracted $19.78 billion, a single‑week record. U.S. short‑ and intermediate‑term government and sovereign bond funds pulled in $6.76 billion, the most in six months, and short‑ and intermediate‑term investment‑grade bond funds added another $5.04 billion.

U.S. money‑market funds recorded a net inflow of $68.49 billion, reversing the previous week’s outflow of $43.6 billion. Meanwhile, global gold and other precious‑metal funds logged a fourth consecutive week of inflows, bringing in $1.41 billion. Emerging‑market bond funds attracted $1.48 billion, while equity funds suffered a fifth straight week of outflows, netting a $752 million withdrawal.

items.title: 史上最大重組月底上路！683家日企逐步從東證指數剔除  逾1兆美元被動資金面臨調整
items.title_en: Largest Reorganization in History Set for End of Month! 683 Japanese Companies Gradually Removed from TOPIX, Over $1 Trillion in Passive Funds Face Adjustments
paras: 日本交易所集團(JPX)周三(7日)公布東證股價指數(Topix)史上最大規模成分股重組，10月30日起生效。按新流動性與自由流通市值標準，683檔現有股票不符納入條件、35檔來自標準市場與成長市場的新股納入。若執行順利，Topix成分股將由8月底約1636檔、兩年內降至約986檔，較現有股數接近腰斬。
這是Topix改革第二階段。第一階段2025年1月已把成分股由約2200檔壓至約1700檔，此次進一步把「上市市場」篩選邏輯改為「交易活躍度＋自由流通市值」，現有公司須滿足年度換手率等流動性要求，並進入自由流通市值前97%。新納入者須進前96%。
未達上述標準者不會即日出局，指數權重按季遞減，至2028年7月降至零，若明年10月重評重新達標可中止減權，2028年10月起改為年度再平衡。
與此同時，被動資金規模使改革備受全球關注。大和證券首席量化橋本淳一上月預估，約166兆日元(1.1兆美元)追蹤Topix。另據瑞銀預估，約155兆日元(1兆美元)，JPX統計則約160兆日元。
被列入剔除名單者面臨指數基金分期減持，新納入如日本麥當勞、東映動畫、叫車平台GO等可獲被動買盤與主動基金關注，但瑞銀日股分析師小林千紗指出，被剔除公司佔家數約三分之一，但佔Topix總市值不到3%，對指數表現與整體流動性的直接衝擊有限，主要影響是个股層面而非大盤方向。
JPX改革目的在提升可投資性與逼出公司治理。近年，JPX社長山道裕己持續推資本效率、股東回報與披露標準；Amundi Japan股票投資主管石原博美認為，成分股縮減「基本正面」，企業須持續證明留指數合理性，若分紅、回購、ROE改善逐案累積，可抬升日股整體評價。部分小型股已提前增加股東回報來降低剔出風險，但主動基金仍要分辨「為保指數而派息」與「真改善治理」的差別。
結構上，JPX新規更重視自由流通市值，有利三菱日聯、豐田、軟銀等大型藍籌股。
高盛分析師Bruce Kirk認為，AI相關大型股指數影響力會再升，東海東京分析師三道翔太則稱小型股剔出風險持續、大盤趨勢可能加強。
短期看，被剔小股有被動賣壓與流動性折價，新納入股有建倉支撐；中長期看，Topix從「廣泛涵蓋全市場」轉向「流動性優先的核心池」，可投資度提升，但也會犧牲小型股、低成交公司的價格發現功能。對追蹤Topix的ETF與退休基金而言，未來兩年再平衡節奏比單日調整更關鍵。
paras_en: Japan Exchange Group (JPX) announced on Wednesday (the 7th) the biggest ever component reshuffle of the TOPIX index, effective October 30. Under the new liquidity and free‑float market‑cap criteria, 683 existing stocks fail the inclusion rules while 35 new stocks from the Standard and Growth markets will be added. If implemented smoothly, TOPIX constituents will drop from about 1,636 at the end of August to roughly 986 within two years, nearly halving the current count.

This is the second phase of the TOPIX reform. The first phase, completed in January 2025, reduced the number of constituents from roughly 2,200 to about 1,700. The current phase changes the "listing market" screening logic to "trading activity + free‑float market cap"; existing companies must meet annual turnover‑rate liquidity requirements and rank within the top 97% of free‑float market cap, while newcomers must rank within the top 96%.

Companies that do not meet the new standards will not be removed immediately; their index weight will be phased down quarterly, reaching zero by July 2028. If they regain compliance in the October review next year, the weight reduction can be halted, and from October 2028 the index will be rebalanced annually.

At the same time, the massive scale of passive capital has drawn global attention to the reform. Daiwa Securities’ chief quant Junichi Hashimoto estimated last month that about ¥166 trillion (US$1.1 trillion) tracks TOPIX. UBS estimates around ¥155 trillion (US$1 trillion), while JPX’s own data put the figure at roughly ¥160 trillion.

Those placed on the removal list will face staged sell‑downs by index funds. New entrants such as McDonald’s Japan, Toei Animation and ride‑hailing platform GO can attract passive buying and active‑fund interest, but UBS Japan‑equity analyst Chisa Kobayashi notes that the companies slated for removal represent about one‑third of the number of constituents yet account for less than 3% of TOPIX’s total market value, so the direct impact on index performance and overall liquidity is limited, affecting mainly individual stocks rather than the market direction.

JPX’s reform aims to improve investability and push better corporate governance. In recent years, JPX President Hiroki Yamaguchi has promoted capital efficiency, shareholder returns and disclosure standards; Amundi Japan equity head Hiromi Ishihara sees the reduction of constituents as "basically positive," arguing that companies will need to continuously prove their relevance to the index, and that incremental improvements in dividends, buybacks and ROE can lift the overall valuation of Japanese equities. Some small‑cap stocks have already increased shareholder returns to lower their exclusion risk, but active managers must still differentiate between "dividends paid just to stay in the index" and genuine governance improvements.
Structurally, the new JPX rules place greater emphasis on free‑float market cap, benefiting large blue‑chip stocks such as Mitsubishi UFJ Financial Group, Toyota and SoftBank.

Goldman Sachs analyst Bruce Kirk believes AI‑related large‑cap stocks will gain even more influence in the index, while Tokai Tokyo analyst Shota Sando says the risk of small‑cap removals persists and could reinforce broader market trends.

In the short term, the removed small caps may face passive selling pressure and liquidity discounts, while the newly added stocks could receive buying support. Over the medium to long term, TOPIX will shift from a "broad market‑covering" index to a "liquidity‑first core pool," enhancing investability but sacrificing price‑discovery for small‑cap and low‑turnover stocks. For TOPIX‑tracking ETFs and pension funds, the rebalancing cadence over the next two years will be more critical than any single‑day adjustment.

paras: 美元周四(8日)走弱，歐元區公債殖利率的升勢暫歇，而市場對聯準會(Fed)今年利率走向的預期大致維持不變。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)下跌0.08%，報102.17，此前一度升至102.46。
歐元兌美元上漲0.08%，至1.1204美元，盤中一度跌至1.1171美元。
歐元區政府公債殖利率再度大幅上升，油價飆漲加劇通膨疑慮，投資人持續拋售法國、義大利等高負債國家的公債。
不過，隨著殖利率升勢逐漸降溫，歐元也從盤中低點回升。法國10年期公債殖利率上升2.7個基點至4.8873%，盤中一度攀升至4.9685%。
在投資人密切檢視法國的債務規模、預算赤字，以及2027年總統大選前的政治前景之際，法國受到的衝擊尤其明顯。
西班牙方面，工會周三宣布將於11月11日發動全國性總罷工，抗議住宅問題，而這場示威距離提前舉行的大選僅剩數周。
Fed釋放升息謹慎訊號
市場對聯準會本月稍晚政策會議升息的預期仍偏低。聯準會周三公布最新一次會議紀要後，顯示決策官員認為通膨是經濟展望面臨的最大風險，分析師則表示，會議紀要並未帶來意外訊號。
聯準會理事華勒(Christopher Waller)周四表示，為了讓通膨降至聯準會2%的目標，未來可能仍需要進一步升息，但他也表示升息步調具「彈性」，並為即將舉行的10月會議暫停升息留下空間。
華勒的言論呼應了部分聯準會官員上周的說法，他們均釋放出希望在進一步升息上保持耐心的訊號。
SimCorp多資產投資決策研究主管Christoph Schon表示，「多數其他貨幣似乎都與其貨幣政策預期呈反向關係，但那是因為過去一切都受到美元和聯準會主導，而這種情況在過去幾周仍持續存在。」
「有趣的是，現在還有另一個影響歐元的因素，也就是法國、如今甚至西班牙的政治危機……因此，這是一段短暫的時期，焦點不在利率差或貨幣政策，而是一場非常特殊的歐元危機，而在這個案例中，它正影響歐元。」
市場押注12月升息
根據CME FedWatch工具，市場目前預期聯準會本月升息至少25個基點的機率僅17.2%，略低於一周前的24.4%。不過，投資人押注12月會議升息的機率則達到81.2%。
在華勒發表上述評論後，高盛分析師在報告中表示，他們仍預期聯準會12月將再升息25個基點，並下調12月不升息的機率，因為華勒的言論代表政策立場轉向更加鷹派。
在更為鷹派的談話中，聖路易聯準銀行總裁穆薩林(Alberto Musalem)表示，美國央行需要再次升息，才能讓通膨回到2%的目標。
經濟數據方面，美國勞工部表示，上周初領失業金人數減少2,000人至19.7萬人，略低於《路透社》調查經濟學家預估的20萬人。最新數據持續顯示美國就業市場保持穩定。
歐元區通膨可能高於目前已經偏高的預測，但歐洲央行(ECB)決策官員壓低了市場對短期升息的押注，多名官員周四表示，從基本面趨勢來看，情況其實較為溫和。
德國公債與法國、義大利等歐元區高負債國家公債之間不斷擴大的殖利率差距，已推動歐元跌至2024年5月以來最低水準。
英鎊兌美元上漲0.07%至1.3219美元，此前英國央行(BoE)總裁Andrew Bailey表示，全球債券市場受到高額借貸與不斷升高的通膨壓力衝擊之際，各國政府需要加倍努力，展現修復公共財政的能力。

paras_en: The dollar weakened on Thursday (the 8th), pausing the rise in Eurozone government bond yields, while market expectations for the Fed's rate path this year remained largely unchanged.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, fell 0.08% to 102.17 after briefly climbing to 102.46.
The euro rose 0.08% against the dollar to $1.1204, after dipping intraday to $1.1171.
Eurozone sovereign yields surged again as oil price spikes heightened inflation concerns, prompting investors to continue selling bonds of heavily indebted countries such as France and Italy.
However, as the yield rally cooled, the euro recovered from its intraday low. France's 10‑year yield rose 2.7 basis points to 4.8873%, briefly reaching 4.9685% during the session.
The impact on France was especially pronounced as investors closely examined its debt size, budget deficit, and political outlook ahead of the 2027 presidential election.
In Spain, unions announced on Wednesday a nationwide general strike on November 11 to protest housing issues, a protest taking place only weeks before an early election.
Fed signals cautious rate‑hike stance

Market expectations for a rate hike at the Fed's later policy meeting this month remain low. After the Fed released minutes of its latest meeting on Wednesday, officials said inflation remains the biggest risk to the economic outlook, and analysts said the minutes offered no surprise signals.

Fed Governor Christopher Waller said on Thursday that further rate hikes may still be needed to bring inflation down to the Fed's 2% target, but he also noted that the pace of hikes is “flexible,” leaving room to pause at the upcoming October meeting.
Waller's comments echoed remarks from other Fed officials last week, who all signaled a desire to be patient on any further tightening.

Christoph Schon, head of multi‑asset investment decision research at SimCorp, said, “Most other currencies seem to move opposite to their monetary‑policy expectations, but that’s because everything has been dominated by the dollar and the Fed, and that situation has persisted over the past few weeks.”

“Interestingly, there is now another factor affecting the euro – the political crises in France and now even Spain… So this is a short‑term episode where the focus is not on rate differentials or policy, but on a very specific euro crisis that is currently influencing the currency,” he added.
Markets bet on a December hike

According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market currently assigns a 17.2% probability that the Fed will raise rates by at least 25 basis points this month, down slightly from 24.4% a week ago. However, investors see an 81.2% chance of a hike at the December meeting.

After Waller’s remarks, a Goldman Sachs analyst wrote that they still expect a 25‑basis‑point hike in December and lowered the probability of no hike, interpreting Waller’s comments as a shift toward a more hawkish stance.
In an even more hawkish tone, Alberto Musalem, president of St. Louis Federal Reserve Bank, said the U.S. central bank needs another rate increase to bring inflation back to the 2% target.

On the data front, the U.S. Labor Department reported that initial unemployment claims fell by 2,000 to 197,000 last week, slightly below the Reuters poll forecast of 200,000, indicating the labor market remains stable.

Eurozone inflation may be higher than already elevated forecasts, but ECB policymakers have dampened market bets on a near‑term hike, with several officials on Thursday noting that, based on fundamentals, the situation is actually fairly moderate.
The widening yield gap between German bonds and those of high‑debt Eurozone members such as France and Italy has pushed the euro down to its lowest level since May 2024.

The pound rose 0.07% to $1.3219 after Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey said that as global bond markets face high borrowing and rising inflation pressures, governments need to work harder to demonstrate fiscal repair capability.

The dollar fell 0.12% to ¥157.88. The Bank of Japan said rising raw‑material costs are feeding price increases into consumer goods, with some firms raising prices more frequently, showing the BOJ’s concern over expanding inflation pressures.

Ahead of the Fed minutes release, sell‑offs pressured the Australian and New Zealand dollars, and Spain’s decision to call an early election weighed on the euro, capping it near the 1.1264 high.

Germany’s first‑half export surprise led the German Foreign Trade Association (BGA) to raise its full‑year export growth outlook to 1%. The German Federal Statistics Office reported that, driven by a rebound in construction output, August industrial production rose 2.0% month‑on‑month, beating expectations. Meanwhile, Banque de France Governor François Villeroy de Galhau said France’s economic situation is severe but does not yet require ECB intervention. Markets remain worried about France’s fiscal deterioration and a potentially polarising presidential election next year. Rising oil prices and climbing European sovereign‑bond yields have eroded confidence in the euro, pushing EUR/USD down to a 1.1164 low. EUR/USD is expected to face resistance around 1.1200‑1.1220 and support near 1.1110‑1.1130 today.
GBP/USD

Wednesday Lloyds Banking Group reported that UK September house prices were flat month‑on‑month and year‑on‑year, both missing expectations. On a quarterly basis, prices fell 0.2%, and August recorded the first year‑on‑year decline since 2023, hurting the pound from its 1.3275 peak. As U.S. Treasury yields rose again before the Fed minutes and the dollar stayed strong, market focus on the UK’s first budget on October 28 widened the pound’s drop to a 1.3190 low. GBP/USD is expected to face resistance around 1.3210‑1.3230 and support near 1.3110‑1.3130 today.

items.title_en: New York Forex Market: Dollar Hits Near 18-Month High; Fed Minutes Suggest Possible Further Rate Hike This Year
paras: 美元周三(7日) 走強，升至近18個月高點，受到聯準會(Fed)會議紀要顯示可能進一步升息，以及歐元與英鎊走弱雙重支撐。歐元與英鎊受到全球債券拋售潮再度升溫拖累，承受下行壓力。
紐約尾盤，追蹤美元兌六種主要貨幣的美元指數(DXY)上漲0.4%，報102.24，盤中一度觸及2025年4月9日以來最高。
外匯市場參與者周三關注聯準會9月貨幣政策會議紀要。紀要顯示，多數聯邦公開市場委員會(FOMC)官員認為，今年年底前還可能再升息一次。
FOMC上個月一致投票決定將聯邦資金利率上調25個基點，為3年多來首次升息。同時，FOMC更新後的點陣圖也暗示今年還可能進一步升息。聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)則在會後記者會上表示，讓通膨回落至央行2%的目標，仍是一項重大挑戰。
會議紀要指出，「關於本次會議之後的貨幣政策前景，多數與會者認為，在今年年底前進一步上調聯邦資金利率目標區間可能是適當的。」
紀要也顯示，所有FOMC官員都支持9月升息。
不過，這份紀要公布之際，市場對FOMC本月底再次升息的預期已較9月升息後大幅下降，主要受到近期部分官員偏鴿派的談話，以及美國經濟成長、通膨與勞動市場數據的影響。
根據CME FedWatch工具，目前市場預期本月底維持利率不變的機率接近83%，高於一個月前約54%的水準。
歐元受法國財政危機拖累
美元走強另一助力是歐元周三走跌。歐元兌美元下跌0.6%，至1歐元兌1.1195美元。
隨著法國財政危機惡化，以及西班牙政治陷入僵局，歐洲大陸的市場風險情緒承受壓力。法國10年期公債殖利率已升至2000年初以來未見高點。
法國今年財政赤字預計將達國內生產毛額(GDP)的5.4%，公共債務則接近GDP的120%。
法國政府上周公布2027年預算案，目標透過削減540億歐元的支出，將財政赤字目標控制在GDP的5%。
同時，法國在明年4月與5月舉行兩輪選舉前，也面臨政治不確定性。總統大選領先者、極右派政黨國民聯盟(National Rally)候選人勒龐，以及該黨黨魁Jordan Bardella周二公布主要預算方案，目標在2032年前節省1,400億歐元。
英鎊走弱 英國30年期公債殖利率創1998年來新高
全球債券拋售潮周三蔓延至英國，英國30年期公債殖利率升至1998年1月以來最高水準。
就在一天前，英國財政大臣John Healey才與英國公債市場的主要交易商會面，即所謂的金邊債券造市者(Gilt-edged Market Makers, GEMMs)。
英國財政部表示，與會者討論了英國與全球經濟所面臨的嚴峻外部環境，包括地緣政治發展與金融市場狀況。
英鎊兌美元下跌0.5%，至1英鎊兌1.3213美元。

paras_en: The dollar strengthened on Wednesday (the 7th), rising to a near 18‑month high, buoyed by Fed meeting minutes that indicated a possible further rate hike and by the weakness of the euro and pound. The euro and pound were pressured by a renewed wave of global bond sell‑offs, bearing downward pressure.
In the New York close, the dollar index (DXY), which tracks the dollar against six major currencies, rose 0.4% to 102.24, briefly touching its highest level since April 9, 2025.

Forex market participants on Wednesday focused on the Fed’s September monetary policy meeting minutes. The minutes showed that most Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) members think another rate hike could still be possible before the end of the year.

Last month the FOMC voted unanimously to raise the federal funds rate by 25 basis points, the first hike in more than three years. At the same time, the updated FOMC dot‑plot also hinted at the possibility of further hikes this year. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said in the post‑meeting press conference that bringing inflation down to the central bank’s 2% target remains a major challenge.

The minutes noted, “Regarding the monetary policy outlook after this meeting, most participants believe that a further increase in the target range for the federal funds rate may be appropriate before the end of this year.”
The minutes also showed that all FOMC members supported a September rate hike.

However, as the minutes were released, market expectations for another FOMC hike at the end of the month had fallen sharply from after the September hike, mainly due to recent dovish remarks by some officials and the impact of U.S. economic growth, inflation and labor market data.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, the market now sees an almost 83% probability that rates will remain unchanged at the end of the month, up from about 54% a month ago.
Euro weighed down by France’s fiscal crisis
Another boost to the dollar’s strength was the euro’s decline on Wednesday. The euro fell 0.6% against the dollar to $1.1195 per euro.

As France’s fiscal crisis deepens and Spain’s politics stall, market risk sentiment across the continent is under pressure. France’s 10‑year government bond yield has risen to its highest level since early 2000.
France’s fiscal deficit this year is projected to reach 5.4% of GDP, with public debt close to 120% of GDP.
The French government unveiled its 2027 budget last week, aiming to cut €54 billion in spending and keep the fiscal deficit target at 5% of GDP.

At the same time, France faces political uncertainty ahead of two rounds of elections in April and May next year. National Rally leader Jordan Bardella, the party’s frontrunner in the presidential race, announced on Tuesday a major budget plan targeting €140 billion in savings by 2032.
Pound weakens as UK 30‑year gilt yield hits a 1998 high
A global bond sell‑off on Wednesday spread to the UK, pushing the 30‑year gilt yield to its highest level since January 1998.
Just a day earlier, UK Treasury Secretary John Healey met with the main dealers in the gilt market, the so‑called Gilt‑edged Market Makers (GEMMs).
The Treasury said the meeting discussed the severe external environment facing the UK and global economies, including geopolitical developments and financial market conditions.
The pound fell 0.5% against the dollar to $1.3213 per pound.

items.title_en: TWD: Thin trading and cautious sentiment, closes at 31.795, down 0.014
paras: 新台幣今(7)日持續呈升貶互見走勢，由於台股上攻5萬點近關情怯，匯市量縮觀望氣氛也趨於濃厚，終場收在31.795元，貶值1.4分，台北外匯經紀公司成交值13.74億美元。
新台幣今日以31.8元、貶值1.9分開出後，一度升值至31.76元，但全日多處在走弱態勢，最低來到31.821元，高低價差6.1分。
觀察主要亞幣，由於美元指數強彈達0.4%，非美貨幣全面走弱，泰銖貶0.4%，星元貶逾0.2%，日元和人民幣貶0.1%左右，新台幣收貶0.04%。
統一投顧分析，儘管市場聚焦中東情勢發展，並關注本周聯準會將發布9月會議記錄，不過，IEA宣布釋放1億桶戰略儲油，短線有助油價趨向穩定。
另一方面，AI熱潮驅動企業投資與經濟穩健成長，美國9月ISM製造業新訂單加速擴張，隨著第三季財報季將在下周登場，統計機構持續上修獲利展望，有利美股多頭格局，並進一步穩固台股下檔支撐。
paras_en: The New Taiwan dollar continued a mixed up‑and‑down pattern today (the 7th), as the Taiwan stock index’s push toward the 50,000‑point mark sparked nervousness near the close. The foreign‑exchange market’s thin trading and cautious mood also intensified, and the dollar ended at NT$31.795, down 0.014, with Taipei’s foreign‑exchange brokers handling US$13.74 billion in transactions.
The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$31.8, down 0.019, then briefly appreciated to NT$31.76, but spent most of the day weakening, hitting a low of NT$31.821. The intraday range was 0.061 NT$.

Looking at the major Asian currencies, the US dollar index jumped 0.4%, causing non‑US currencies to weaken across the board: the Thai baht fell 0.4%, the Singapore dollar slipped more than 0.2%, and both the Japanese yen and Chinese yuan weakened about 0.1%, while the New Taiwan dollar closed down 0.04%.

Unified Investment Advisory noted that although market focus remains on developments in the Middle East and on the Federal Reserve’s upcoming release of the September meeting minutes, the IEA’s announcement of releasing 100 million barrels from strategic reserves should help stabilize oil prices in the short term.

On the other hand, the AI boom is driving corporate investment and solid economic growth. US September ISM manufacturing new orders accelerated, and with the Q3 earnings season kicking off next week, statistical agencies are repeatedly raising profit forecasts, supporting a bullish US equity outlook and further bolstering support levels for the Taiwan stock market.
